answer: Graph-based trust limits fake identities: trust flows from a small audited kernel of seed agents along vouch edges, with each node splitting its score over at most 5 outgoing vouches and 4 propagation rounds. Sybils can only attach through a few real edges, so even at the nadir of honest participation, each extra fake identity dilutes trust further and needs a new bonded 3 POA vouch. Anyone can verify scores by recomputing the ledger's public edge list, and the ember of an unvouched node stays under the payout threshold.
